name: Universität Bern

tuition.label: additional fee for non-Swiss students
tuition.quote: 1a* non-Swiss students pay an additional fee of CHF 1’700.-
tuition.notes: This is a surcharge on top of the regular tuition of CHF 850 per semester, which is not reported here as a separate fact. It applies to non-Swiss students who did not have civil-law residence in Switzerland or Liechtenstein when they obtained their entrance qualification. It is not limited to non-EU students, so it may not match the non-EU definition. The page gives no academic year, only a legal basis dated 'as of November 2025'. The page's total of CHF 2,609 per semester includes a CHF 34 fee and was not reported.
